name: Profit_Ratio
explanation: Legacy DAX inverted the numerator and denominator (swapped Sales and Profit) and used the raw '/' operator instead of the safe 'DIVIDE()' function.

name: Region_Sales
explanation: Legacy DAX completely omitted the Level of Detail (FIXED) context modifier, reducing a regional fixed grain calculation to an unconstrained simple sum.

name: Advanced_KPI
explanation: Legacy DAX truncated a compound multi-part conditional calculation into a single inner scalar aggregation, losing conditions and table calculations.
corrected_dax: IF(CALCULATE(SUM(Table[Sales]), ALLEXCEPT(Table, Table[Region])) > 10000, DIVIDE(AVG(Table[Profit]), SUM(Table[Sales])), CALCULATE(SUM(Table[Profit]), ALLSELECTED(Table)))
ground_truth_dax: IF(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales), ALLEXCEPT(Table, Table[Region])) > 10000, DIVIDE(AVG(Profit), SUM(Sales)), CALCULATE(SUM(Profit), FILTER(ALL(Table), ...)))

name: Sales_Category
explanation: Legacy DAX returned numeric values (1, 0) instead of textual category labels ('High', 'Low'), violating the expected return data type.
